songs.name: Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad

ai_show_review.summary: Epic Eyes of the World jam, tight Truckin'>Stella Blue, bright early set
ai_show_review.blurb: The Cincinnati Gardens show delivers a soaring opening with Johnny B. Goode and an energetic first set that flows into a standout China Cat > I Know You Rider. The second set shines with an extended Eyes Of The World jam and a seamless Truckin' > Stella Blue transition, closing strong on Sugar Magnolia and One More Saturday Night. Overall the performance is high‑energy and well captured on the Miller SBD.
ai_show_review.review: December 4, 1973 at Cincinnati Gardens finds the Dead firing on all cylinders. After an upbeat kickoff with Johnny B. Goode, the band rides a wave of momentum through classics like China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider and a rousing Big River, before diving into one of the night’s highlights – an expansive Eyes Of The World that builds into a joyous Sugar Magnolia finale. The Truckin' > Stella Blue segue is another high point, with Jerry’s lead soaring over Phil’s thunder‑ous bass bombs and Bill’s driving snare work. Keith pads the jams with tasteful chords while Donna adds her signature vocal lift, and Bob’s rhythm guitar pushes the groove forward. The set closes on a bright One More Saturday Night, leaving the audience buzzing. Captured cleanly by Charlie Miller, this soundboard version offers crisp instrument separation and enough length to appreciate the band’s interplay throughout the abbreviated but memorable evening.

best_recording.reason: Miller’s soundboard transfer is clear, captures the full set, and highlights the band’s high‑energy playing with excellent instrument balance

key_highlights: Epic Eyes Of The World jam that showcases Jerry and Phil’s tight duet
Seamless Truckin' > Stella Blue transition with soaring guitar leads
Superb China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider segue early in the set
Bright opening energy on Johnny B. Goode and solid close with Sugar Magnolia

band_performance.Jerry: Delivers crisp, soaring leads on Johnny B. Goode and the Eyes Of The World jam; his tone shines through the Truckin' > Stella Blue transition.
band_performance.Phil: Provides powerful bass bombs that drive the extended Eyes Of The World improvisation and lock in tightly with Jerry’s guitar.
band_performance.Bob: Adds solid rhythm chops, especially on Sugar Magnolia and the early upbeat numbers, keeping the groove steady.
band_performance.Keith: Offers tasteful chordal support throughout, seasoning the Eyes jam and adding texture to the China Cat > I Know You Rider flow.
band_performance.Billy: Bill’s snappy snare work underpins the high‑energy jams, particularly during the expansive Eyes Of The World section.
